name: Day In
source:
Today is your day off! What will you do with your time? Will you tackle one of the many chores you've been neglecting, or find something else to enjoy?

[From [url=https://gossqmer.itch.io/day-in]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
今天是你的休息日！你会用你的时间做什么？你会解决你一直忽视的众多杂务中的一项，还是找到其他可以享受的事情？

[来自[url=https://gossqmer.itch.io/day-in]Itch.io[/url]]
